# package uafx

```go
import "github.com/otfabric/go-opcua/uafx"
```

Package uafx reads the OPC UA FX (UAFX) information model of a server: OPC 10000-81 version 1.00.04, Connecting Devices and Information Model.

Inspect reports the UAFX namespaces of a server with their versions, the FxRoot object (Part 81 §12.2), the AutomationComponents FxRoot organizes with their Assets, FunctionalEntities, ConnectionEndpoints, health and descriptors, and the ConnectionManager (§12.3). Deviations from Part 81 that it can see in the address space, such as a missing mandatory member or a missing namespace, are Findings of the report.

	r, err := uafx.Inspect(ctx, client, uafx.Limits{})
	if err != nil { ... }
	for _, ac := range r.AutomationComponents {
		fmt.Println(ac.BrowseName.Name, ac.AggregatedHealth)
	}

EstablishConnections and CloseConnections call the Methods of an AutomationComponent that establish and close connections (§6.2.4, §6.2.5); package fxserver serves them. The structures of their arguments and the codecs that encode them with the namespace index of the server are in this package. Verify, VerifyAsset and the Methods of the ConnectionManager have no client functions.

The NodeIds of the UAFX namespaces are in packages fxdataid, fxacid and fxcmid, those of the DI model (OPC 10000-100) the UAFX model builds on in package di/diid. Package fxserver adds the UAFX model to a server.

## Variables

```go
var ErrCall = errors.New("uafx: call")
```

ErrCall reports that a call of EstablishConnections or CloseConnections failed: the server has no UAFX namespaces, the AutomationComponent no such Method, or the call returned a Bad status or a result that does not decode. A Bad status of the call is in the chain: errors.As with a ua.StatusCode finds it.

```go
var ErrCodec = errors.New("uafx: codec")
```

ErrCodec reports a UAFX structure that cannot be encoded or decoded.

```go
var ErrInspect = errors.New("uafx: inspect")
```

ErrInspect wraps the errors of Inspect that end the inspection: a failed service call, not a deviation of the model, which is a Finding.


ProcessConnectionConfigurationSets calls ProcessConnectionConfigurationSets of the ConnectionManager of the server (Part 81 §6.7.5, §12.3) with action for the ConnectionConfigurationSet Objects sets. The Method returns once the processing started; the ConnectionConfigurationSet events (§8.7 to §8.9) and the state machines of the sets tell the outcome. #### func EstablishConnections

```go
func EstablishConnections(ctx context.Context, c *opcua.Client, ac *ua.NodeID, req *EstablishConnectionsRequest) (*EstablishConnectionsResult, error)
```

EstablishConnections calls the EstablishConnections Method of the AutomationComponent ac (Part 81 §6.2.4). It resolves the index of the UAFX Data namespace from the NamespaceArray of the server. A call the server aborted returns a result with Status Uncertain and the per-command results that tell what failed (§6.2.4.3.11); a Bad status of the call (Table 9) is an error.

#### func Inspect

```go
func Inspect(ctx context.Context, c *opcua.Client, limits Limits) (*Report, error)
```

Inspect reads the UAFX model of the server c is connected to: the namespaces, FxRoot, the AutomationComponents with their Assets, FunctionalEntities and ConnectionEndpoints, and the ConnectionManagers. A node that is missing or cannot be read is left out of the report or becomes a Finding; Inspect returns an error only when a service call fails. Its Browse and Read requests ask for one node at a time, or as many as the MaxNodesPerRead of the server allows (Part 5 §6.3.11).

#### func (Report) HasFXNamespaces

```go
func (r *Report) HasFXNamespaces() bool
```

HasFXNamespaces reports whether the server has the namespaces Part 81 §14.2 (Table 260) makes mandatory for a UAFX server: DI, the UAFX Data namespace and at least one of AC and CM. It says nothing about the model in them.

#### func (Report) IsFXServer

```go
func (r *Report) IsFXServer() bool
```

IsFXServer reports whether the server has the structure of a UAFX server: the namespaces of HasFXNamespaces and FxRoot, which every server that exposes the UAFX model has (Part 81 §12.2). It is not a conformance statement: Findings lists what Inspect saw deviate from Part 81, and the behaviour of the model is not inspected at all.

#### func (Report) Namespace

```go
func (r *Report) Namespace(uri string) (Namespace, bool)
```

Namespace returns the namespace uri of the report, and whether the server has it.

#### func DecodeStructure

```go
func DecodeStructure(eo *ua.ExtensionObject, ns NamespaceIndexes) (Structure, error)
```

DecodeStructure decodes the ExtensionObject eo, a structure of a UAFX namespace in the binary encoding, for a server with the namespace indexes ns. It returns nil for a null ExtensionObject. The body must hold exactly the structure.
